description: Export a robotics collection program's accepted-items manifest (buyer token, robotics:read): scrubbed media refs, LeRobot episode refs + workspace episode links + QA flags, annotation atoms (teleop), and per-item consent refs. Refuses with 409 while any accepted item awaits its PII scrub or, on rights-STRICT programs, while any contribution lacks its consent grant.
name: opentrain_export_robotics_dataset
